units.source_text: 当时称为按察大纳言的人，是已故的致仕太政大臣的次子红梅，亦即已故卫门督柏木的长弟。

en.t: The man then known as the Inspector Grand Counselor was Kobai, the second son of the late retired Grand Minister, and the next younger brother of the late Captain Kashiwagi of the Gate Guards.

units.source_text: 此人从小天资聪慧，性情优雅。

en.t: From childhood he was naturally intelligent and refined in temperament.

units.source_text: 年事渐长，官位日升，前程远大，荣华盖世，圣眷隆重无比。

en.t: As he grew older, his rank rose steadily, his prospects became brilliant, his glory surpassed all others, and the emperor's favor toward him was beyond compare.

units.source_text: 这红梅大纳言有两位夫人，先娶的一位已经亡故，

en.t: This Grand Counselor Kobai had had two wives; the one he married first had already died,

units.source_text: 现在的一位是后任太政大臣髭黑之女，就是从前舍不得真木柱的那位女公子。

en.t: and his present wife was the daughter of Higekuro, the later Grand Minister, the young lady once known as Makibashira, who had been so hard to part from.

units.source_text: 起初，她的外祖父式部卿亲王把她嫁给萤兵部卿亲王。

en.t: At first, her maternal grandfather, Prince Shikibukyo, had married her to Prince Hotaru, Minister of War.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王逝世之后，红梅和她私通。

en.t: After Prince Hotaru, Minister of War, passed away, Kobai entered into a secret relationship with her.

units.source_text: 年月既久，也顾不得世评，就把她当了继室。

en.t: As the years went by, he stopped caring about public opinion and took her as his second wife.

units.source_text: 红梅的前妻只生下两个女儿，没有儿子，未免寂寞。

en.t: Kobai's first wife had borne only two daughters and no son, which left him feeling somewhat lonely.

units.source_text: 祷告神佛，继室真木柱果然生了一个儿子。

en.t: After prayers to the gods and Buddhas, his second wife Makibashira did indeed give birth to a son.

units.source_text: 真木柱还有前夫萤兵部卿亲王所生的一个女儿，带在身边，视为前夫遗念。

en.t: Makibashira also had a daughter by her former husband, Prince Hotaru, Minister of War, and kept the child beside her as a keepsake of him.
